source.section: Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Highlights
source.quote: Adjusted free cash flow for the fiscal third quarter was an inflow of $229 million compared to an inflow of $118 million in the prior year.
The Company's Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per common share payable on June 22, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on June 5, 2026.

extendedMetrics.label: Buyback (this quarter or YTD if only YTD disclosed)

source.quote: During the fiscal third quarter, the Company spent $150 million to repurchase approximately 1.05 million shares of its common stock at an average cost of approximately $143 per share.
Achieved GAAP Diluted EPS of $1.65, up 74% Versus Prior Year, and Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $1.66, an Increase of 62% Versus Prior Year
